data.description: Pause entries in .worklog/downtime-dispatches.log currently only show '3 consecutive wl CLI errors — pausing dispatch for 3600000ms.' with no underlying error (timeout, SQLITE_BUSY, parse failure, stderr). Extend the wl-error path to propagate the underlying error message into recordError so the pause entry is actionable.
data.title: Downtime pause log should include underlying wl error details
